message.content:
Yes, Coca-Cola originally contained cocaine. Here's the history:

**The Original Formula (1886)**
Coca-Cola was invented in 1886 by Dr. John Stith Pemberton, an Atlanta pharmacist. The original formula contained extract from coca leaves, which naturally contained cocaine. At the time, cocaine was legal and commonly used in patent medicines as a stimulant and pain reliever. The name "Coca-Cola" comes from two of its original ingredients: the **coca** leaf (source of cocaine) and the **kola** nut (source of caffeine).

**Removal of Cocaine**
The cocaine content was gradually reduced over time:
- **1903**: The Coca-Cola Company stopped using fresh coca leaves and switched to "spent" or de-cocainized coca leaves, which contained only trace amounts of cocaine.
- **By 1929**: Coca-Cola was completely cocaine-free.

**Today's Coca-Cola**
Modern Coca-Cola still uses a coca leaf extract, but it is processed to remove all cocaine. The Stepan Company in New Jersey is the only facility in the U.S. authorized by the DEA to import coca leaves and extract the cocaine-free flavoring for Coca-Cola. The removed cocaine is sold for legitimate medical purposes.

The original formula reportedly contained about 9mg of cocaine per glass in Pemberton's earliest batches, which was later reduced to about one-tenth of that amount before being eliminated entirely.

Sources:
1. https://oboe.com/learn/the-secret-coca-cola-formula-cf0ias/evolution-of-the-formula-the-secret-coca-cola-formula-1
2. https://www.thetakeout.com/1788713/why-coca-cola-had-cocaine/
3. https://www.avenuesrecovery.com/understanding-addiction/cocaine-and-crack-addiction/was-there-cocaine-in-coca-cola/
4. https://thetraininggyms.com/blog/coca-cola-is-worse-than-cocaine/
5. https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.17560
